description: Local memory in a SQLite file you choose, with provenance on every recalled memory.
name: mneme-local

memory_write.description: Enable memory storage, recall, replay and two-step forgetting in the selected database. Some reads can initialize or migrate state.
memory_write.title: Allow memory changes

state_path.description: Absolute path of the SQLite state file. Its parent folder must exist.
state_path.title: Mneme state database
